headline: SG freebies: free Jurong Lake Gardens magnetic pin via stamp rally to 14 Nov, plus a free Pokémon postcard at Jewel + 10 more
verdict: Do the Jurong Lake Gardens stamp rally this weekend: it's free, every finisher gets an exclusive magnetic pin, and it ends 14 Nov.

plan.do: Jurong Lake Gardens: get stamps at 3 info counters and finish the crossword for a free magnetic pin. Go early: while stocks last.
Jewel L1 opposite Porsche: free Pokémon 30th giveaway (12–9pm). Then do the TCG quiz rally for a free postcard at the B1 counter.
VivoCity Book Street stamp rally, last day: 2 free illustrations. Next door at Harbourfront Library: S.U.R.E. bookmark and a Taste of Home stamp.
Indian Heritage Centre, last day: a quiz gets you a Deepavali money packet. Walk to City Square Mall B1 for a Warrior 24/7 key charm.

items.name: Explore Jurong Lake Gardens stamp rally
items.why: Free exclusive pin, guaranteed for finishers, ends 14 Nov
items.reward: Exclusive Jurong Lake Gardens magnetic pin, random design
items.todo: Get the booklet, collect stamps at 3 info counters, finish the crossword, redeem.
items.venue: Any Jurong Lake Gardens Information Counter

items.name: Pokémon TCG Quiz Rally postcard
items.why: Free special-edition Pokémon 30th postcard, no purchase needed
items.todo: Find the 27 giant cards on B1–L5, answer the quiz, redeem at the B1 counter.
items.venue: Jewel B1 Atrium counter, between Birkenstock and ZARA

items.name: Pokémon 30th Anniversary giveaways
items.why: Free Pokémon goodies, this weekend only, same trip as postcard
items.reward: Free Pokémon goodies, only revealed on site
items.todo: Turn up at the giveaway point; arrive near 12pm.
items.limits: While stocks last, first come, first served
